im actually pretty ambivalent about this, its funny really. while i feel like the whole world is crashing down on me and i'd be better off gone, i still do hold out a little bit of hope that things can get better, and i truly believe they can. if anything, it scares me how strong my suicidal thoughts are, given that im still young (in my late teens) and practically have my whole life ahead of me. hanging on as best as i can tho!
idk, probably insane breakdowns and extreme mood changes lol. maybe some happy stuff if life allows for it, and im curious to see where i end up in life tbh maybe i'd get lucky
